name: Apple Dumplings
summary: Whole pared apples wrapped in pastry and baked, served with a hard sauce.
ingredients: 6 sour apples, small and even in size
Hard sauce or cream, to serve

equipment.help: The pastry must set before the apples collapse, and that start differs by oven.
equipment.label: Oven

steps.title: Choose the apples
steps.body: Pick six small sour apples of the same size, so they finish together.

steps.title: Make the pastry
steps.body: Cut the cold fat into the flour and salt until it looks like coarse meal, then bring it together with ice water.

steps.title: Rest the pastry
steps.body: Wrap and chill it until firm.

steps.title: Pare and core
steps.body: Pare the apples and take the cores out whole, leaving the apple in one piece.
steps.note: A corer is worth having here. A knife works, but it is easy to split the apple.

steps.title: Roll and cut
steps.body: Roll the pastry thin and cut six squares, each big enough to wrap an apple.

steps.title: Fill and wrap
steps.body: Stand an apple on each square. Put a teaspoon of sugar, a pinch of spice and a piece of butter in the hollow, then draw the pastry up and pinch it closed.

steps.title: Heat a gas oven to 425°F
steps.body: Start hot so the pastry sets, and keep the dumplings off the floor of a gas oven.

steps.title: Heat an electric oven to 425°F
steps.body: A preheated sheet under the dish helps the bottoms cook through.

steps.title: Heat a convection oven to 400°F
steps.body: Drop the heat for the fan. The tops brown fast, so check early.

steps.title: Bake hot, then lower
steps.body: Bake hot for ten minutes to set the pastry, then lower the oven to 350°F.

steps.title: Finish baking
steps.body: Bake until the apples are tender when a skewer goes in easily and the pastry is golden.

steps.title: Serve warm
steps.body: Serve warm with hard sauce or cream.
